name: Reversible Discrete Volume Polyhedrization using Marching Cubes Simplification
aliases: Marching Cubes Simplification with Digital Plane Segmentation
Reversible discrete volume polyhedrization using MC simplification
definition: A method to construct a reversible and topologically correct polyhedron from a binary 3D discrete volume by simplifying a Marching Cubes (MC) surface using digital plane segmentation (DPS) information to reduce facet count while preserving reversibility and topology.
